description: IEEE 39, IEEE 118 and a real world provincial power system cascading failure dataset is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Yan Yang, Tengfei Yu. "An AC-based cascading failure simulation model (AC-CFM) is employed to generate simulation data, capturing the power system\u2019s dynamic behavior and fault propagation patterns under varying renewable energy penetration and load fluctuations. Coverage: global; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
